design_deviation_from_phase_plan: Phase file left keyset-vs-offset pagination open. Chose Spring Data's offset Page/Pageable (explicit page/size query params, not the client-facing Sort/Pageable auto-binding) rather than reusing InternalExportController's keyset-cursor pattern: keyset exists there for a system-to-system full-tenant historical export; this is an interactive single-tenant host review screen where offset paging is simpler and sufficient — deliberately two different patterns for two different access shapes, not an inconsistency.

findings.summary: PageRequest.of(page, size) throws IllegalArgumentException for a negative page index, which GlobalExceptionHandler has no specific mapping for and would surface as an unintended 500 instead of a client error.
findings.failure_scenario: A host (or a buggy client) calls GET /answers?page=-1 and gets HTTP 500 instead of a clean 400 or a coerced first page.
findings.required_action: Fixed inline: added boundedPage() clamping any null/negative page to 0, mirroring the existing boundedSize() pattern already in this controller.

receipt_note: Same limitation as prior phases — result recorded directly in the phase file's Quality and Testing State.
